case_name: Shakuntala Sinha And Ors vs Manju Sinha And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shakuntala Sinha, Amit Kumar Sinha, Vikas Kumar Sinha (wife and sons of Late Murli Manohar Sinha)
parties.respondent_defendant: Manju Sinha, Rashmi Sinha, Renu Sinha, Sushiv Sinha (wife and children of Late Murli Manohar Sinha)

facts_of_case: Late Murli Manohar Sinha died. Respondents claimed succession certificate. Petitioners also claimed succession. Trial court granted certificate to respondents. Petitioners appealed.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party challenging a finding of fact to demonstrate that it is perverse and calls for interference.
legal_principles.held: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned order as also the records of the two Courts below extensively and meticulously.
cited_cases: Chanmuniya v. Virendra Kumar Singh Kushwaha and another, (2011) 1 SCC 141
use_in: appeal against a finding of fact

legal_principles.principle: A court's findings of fact are binding on the appellate court unless they are perverse.
legal_principles.held: The Succession Court has clearly recorded a finding that marriage of Late Murli Manohar Sinha was solemnized with Manju Sinha on 12/13-3-1976.
use_in: appeal against a finding of fact

outcome.final_order: Petitioners No.2 and 3 are entitled for succession certificate along with respondents No.1 to 4.
